title: CORE-7322 · [RF] /compare-packages/ — Comparison-grid "not included" minus icon wrong size and colour
body:
Linear: https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7322/rf-compare-packages-comparison-grid-not-included-minus-icon-wrong-size

(Reference only — the ticket is the source of truth; fetch the live description at implement time.)

Imported by Planning 2026-09-04 as part of the board↔Linear sync: this ticket was open and assigned at Todo in Linear but had no row on the board.
acceptanceCriteria: On /compare-packages/ desktop comparison grid, the 'not included' minus icon renders at 28.4×32.5px (matching Live) at 768, 1024 and 1800 breakpoints — not the current ~13.1×15px.
The 'not included' minus icon colour is rgb(199,199,199) (light grey, matching Live) at 768, 1024 and 1800 — not the current rgb(54,54,54) dark grey.
The 'included' green checkmark icon (28.4×32.5px, rgb(46,204,113)) is unchanged/not regressed at all breakpoints.
At 360px, the icon remains not rendered on the clone (matches Live's behaviour at that width — not a regression to introduce rendering where Live has none).
Fix is scoped to the desktop grid (ComparePackageTable, excluding MobileCarousel.tsx) and does not touch /compare-packages/guarantee/.
